note: Pond OS specific plugins — merged into main plugins.json catalog

plugins.name: ESPHome Pond Sensor Pack
plugins.description: ESPHome configuration for pond sensors: DS18B20 water temperature, HC-SR04 water level, Atlas Scientific EZO pH/DO/EC, SEN0189 turbidity, ORP. Provides native HA integration with auto-discovery.

plugins.name: ReefPi Integration
plugins.description: Home Assistant integration for ReefPi — the open-source Raspberry Pi aquarium and pond controller. Exposes temperature sensors, equipment switches, and dosing pumps as HA entities.

plugins.name: AquaPi (ESPHome Aquarium)
plugins.description: ESPHome-based aquarium and pond controller with support for Atlas Scientific EZO sensors (pH, DO, EC, RTD), thermistors, optical liquid sensors. Full HA auto-discovery via native API.

plugins.name: Frigate NVR (Pond Camera)
plugins.description: Use Frigate NVR for pond camera monitoring. Detects animals, motion, and intrusion around your pond. Integrates with HA via MQTT. Define pond zones for targeted alerts (e.g., heron detection).

plugins.name: MQTT — Pond Telemetry Bridge
plugins.description: Publish pond sensor readings to MQTT broker. Compatible with ESPHome pond_controller.yaml. Topic structure: pond/{device}/telemetry. Integrates with Node-RED for custom automation flows and Grafana for historical dashboards.

plugins.name: Node-RED — Pond Automation
plugins.description: Node-RED flows for pond automation: pH alert routing, dissolved oxygen triggered aerator control, feeding schedule automation, water change reminders. Includes EZO calibration flows.

plugins.name: InfluxDB — Pond Time Series
plugins.description: Time-series database for long-term water quality history. Store months of pH, temperature, DO, turbidity readings. Pairs with Grafana for custom dashboards. PRVIO Pond OS uses Supabase for this — use InfluxDB if you need millisecond precision or >2 year retention.

plugins.name: Seneye Pond Monitor
plugins.description: Home Assistant integration for Seneye pond and aquarium monitors. Provides water temperature, NH3 (free ammonia), pH, LUX (light), slide expiry alerts. Requires Seneye Web Server (SWS) device.

plugins.name: Irrigation Unlimited (Pond Refill)
plugins.description: Schedule automated pond water top-off and refill cycles. Integrates with water level sensors to trigger fill valve on low level, stop on high level. Handles seasonal water changes and evaporation compensation.

plugins.name: Powercalc (Pond Energy Monitoring)
plugins.description: Calculate power consumption of pond equipment (pump, aerator, UV, heater) even without smart plugs. Uses manufacturer wattage data. Tracks pond running costs in HA Energy Dashboard and PRVIO Pond OS energy section.
